# Confirm mixed opportunity statuses are split into the right dashboard totals

## What & Why
The dashboard separates active opportunities into In motion and On deck. The current regression covers a single Closed opportunity, but a future change could count active statuses in the wrong bucket when several opportunities coexist.

## Done looks like
- A browser test in artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts creates opportunities with Saved, Preparing, Applied, and Closed statuses.
- After reload, In motion counts only non-Saved, non-Closed opportunities and On deck counts only Saved opportunities.

## Relevant files
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
